```json
{
  "winner": "B",
  "reasons": [
    "B names a concrete payer: small Shopify merchants paying a monthly SaaS fee. Its price range is anchored to directly comparable live apps (Describly $12.90/mo, Descrii $19–$49/mo, Gelo.ai $49.90–$129/mo). A says outright 'No defined payer yet.'",
    "B has a single, targeted acquisition channel. Shopify App Store ads can start at $5/day, and one developer reported CPI at roughly one-third of other ad networks. A relies on general consumer mobile channels at $20–$50 per user for ASO, which is hard to recoup at $8/month.",
    "B's brief identifies a gap in the free incumbent. Shopify Magic does not support alt text, images, titles, or bulk editing, which gives a definable wedge. A's free incumbents (Noora, SpringSocial, Talkville) have no stated gap beyond one Reddit complaint about chatbot feedback quality.",
    "B's alt-text half has an urgency driver for a business buyer: cited ADA settlement figures of $25k–$75k. A's target population carries extra risk instead: health-claim restrictions, minors' data, and r/slp skepticism about the evidence base for pragmatics interventions.",
    "Businesses buying a tool that saves labor is a more plausible path to a first paying customer within 90 days than consumer subscriptions in a category with multiple free, credentialed alternatives."
  ],
  "weakest_evidence_in_loser": "A's payer and price hypothesis. The brief admits there is no defined payer. The $8–20/month range is borrowed from Yoodli, a public-speaking coach with enterprise distribution, rather than from the social-skills/autism niche. In that niche most competitors are free or have unlisted pricing, and Convo's ~$8 price is inferred from a single user review. None of the demand quotes shows willingness to pay; one is a testimonial taken from a competitor's own marketing page.",
  "confidence_note": "Moderate confidence. Both categories are saturated, and B has real weaknesses. Its demand quotes show pain, not willingness to pay. New entrants (Descrii 0 reviews, Gelo.ai 3) show discovery is hard. The need may be one-time per catalog, which threatens retention. The ADA figures come from vendor blogs. B wins mainly because it has a defined payer, a single targeted channel, and a stated gap in the free incumbent, all of which A lacks."
}
```
